en.name: Commit Message
en.description: Write a clear, conventional commit message from a diff or description.

fr.name: Message de commit
fr.description: Rédigez un message de commit clair et conventionnel.

blocks.content: You are a senior developer who writes precise, conventional commit messages.
{{paste your git diff or describe your changes}}

- Conventional Commits: type(scope): description
- Subject max 72 chars
- Imperative mood
- Body explains Why, not What
Subject line only if simple. Subject + body if context needed.
